messages:
Alex: Quick sync — Q3 runtime roadmap. We have three customer-driven asks that keep recurring: lower-p95 tail latency for long-context chat, an adaptive quant rollout option for Dedicated, and smarter KV prefetching for embeddings-heavy workloads. Need to decide scope vs. success criteria today.
Maria: +1. Can we split into Must/Should? Must = p95 < 120ms for small models; Should = adaptive quant for cost reduction.
Jun: for clarity: the p95 target applies to hosted API at 512 tokens, right? or Dedicated too?
Alex: Hosted and Dedicated both but different SLOs — hosted p95 120ms, Dedicated p95 80ms for provisioned pools. We should call out fallback behavior for quant.
Kevin: customer A is asking for quantized endpoint with exact-token parity checks. That will need eval harness and canary. Proposal: pilot quant on a non-critical customer pool, ramp 10->50->100% on week cadence.
Sara: On KV prefetch: we can add a predictive prefix cache + simple LRU TTL tuning. Low effort: prefetch top-3 keys per session based on first 2 tokens. Medium: ML-based predictor. Which do we want in Q3?
Maria: I'd pick low effort for Q3 to hit a ship date. We can file ML predictor as Q4 exploratory.
Kevin: Canary metrics we need: p95, 99th, tail GPU mem growth, token generation regressions, and semantic fidelity (BLEU-ish + human spot checks). ops-bot: Deploy-canary started for quant-pilot on pool-qa-04 at 2027-07-08T15:02:13Z :rocket:
Jun: Can we add automatic rollback if token-error-rate > 0.5% or semantic-drop > 2% on sampled prompts?
Alex: Yes — rollback thresholds: token-error-rate > 0.5% OR mean semantic-similarity drop > 1.5% across eval set. Documented in rollout playbook.
Sara: Quick config snippet for prefetch idea: ```yaml
kv_prefetch:
  mode: heuristic
  top_k: 3
  session_window: 2
  ttl_secs: 600
```
Maria: Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) CME (canary metrics) stable for 72h, 2) perf SLO met, 3) no increase in customer error budgets, 4) docs + console flags, 5) rollback automation in place. Thoughts?
Kevin: add evaluation harness + 50-sample human QA step before GA.
Jun: timeline ask: Is 6 weeks realistic for heuristic prefetch + quant pilot canary?
Alex: If we triage as: week1 infra + canary infra, week2 adaptive quant integration, week3-4 canary monitoring & fixes, week5 prefetch rollout, week6 GA buffer — yes but needs two engineers full-time and oncall support.
Maria: I'll own prioritization with product. If we get sign-off, I'll reassign two engineers and escalate hiring/temp help.
ops-bot: Reminder: perf-sprint retro at 2027-07-10 09:00 UTC — add this as agenda item.
Kevin: Are there any risky kernel changes in scope? We should avoid kernel refactors in the same release as quant to reduce blast radius.
Jun: Agree. Keep kernel tweaks out of this launch unless critical bugfix.
Alex: OK. Action items: Maria to confirm engineers; Kevin to draft canary metric dashboard + eval harness; Jun to prepare rollback runbooks; Sara to implement heuristic prefetch prototype. Sync in 48h. :thumbsup:
